series.name: Last Seen Online
series.tagline: Her last Instagram story was at 11:47 PM. She hasn't been seen since.
series.concept: Someone disappears. The only clues are digital — WhatsApp last seen, Instagram stories, UPI transactions, Google Maps timeline. Each episode is a different disappearance. The audience pieces together what happened using the same apps they use every day.

episodes.title: 11:47 PM

slides.text: Priya Malhotra posted an Instagram story at 11:47 PM. Rooftop bar. Laughing. Tagged three friends. Her WhatsApp last seen: 11:52 PM. She hasn't been online since.
At 11:55 PM, she booked an Ola ride. Destination: her apartment in Andheri. But at 11:56 — one minute later — the ride was cancelled. By her. She never booked another one.
At 12:03 AM, her PhonePe shows a Rs 40 UPI transfer. Not to Ola. Not to Swiggy. To a number registered under Ravi K. Nobody in her contact list has that name.
Google Maps Timeline shows her phone moved from the bar to a location 2 km away at 12:08 AM. A street with no CCTV. The phone stayed there for 14 minutes. Then it went dead.
Her three tagged friends say she left the bar alone at 11:50. She seemed fine. But one friend's Instagram shows she deleted a story from that night. What was in it?
Rs 40. That's the auto fare from the bar to that street. She didn't book an Ola. She took an auto. And she paid the driver via UPI. Ravi K. is an auto driver.
So someone needs to find Ravi K. The auto driver is the last person who saw her. But here's the thing — that UPI number? It was deactivated the next morning.

episodes.synopsis: A 24-year-old woman posts an Instagram story at 11:47 PM from a rooftop bar. Her WhatsApp goes offline at 11:52. Her Ola ride was booked at 11:55 but cancelled at 11:56. Her UPI shows a Rs 40 transaction at 12:03 AM. To whom?
episodes.caption: Her phone told a story she couldn't. Rs 40 to a stranger. A cancelled ride. A dead phone. What do you think happened to Priya?
